subject: Conditional credit schedule & conversion economics — HelioWorks POC

Subject: Conditional credit schedule & conversion economics — HelioWorks POC

Hi Sam —

Following our call, please find a concise mutual action plan (MAP) and the conditional credit schedule we discussed. High-level summary:

- POC window: 60 days from first API call to production-like datasets.
- Pilot credits: 75k token credits allocated up front.
- Credit extension option: +30 days (up to 90 days total) if HelioWorks commits to a 12-month paid contract within 30 days of POC acceptance.
- Conversion pricing anchor: baseline $0.0009/token; 10% discount at 500M mo tokens, 18% at 1B mo tokens with staged ramp clauses.

Attached: MAP_v1.pdf (proposed dates, acceptance criteria, deliverables).

Can you confirm whether procurement/legal should be on the MAP doc now or after you sign off on the schedule? If you want the +30 day extension, we should lock in the 12-month anchor now.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional credit schedule & conversion economics — HelioWorks POC

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear MAP. A few quick questions from our side before we loop procurement/legal:

1) Can the credit pool be applied across multiple projects within our org or is it scoped to a single project ID?
2) If we trigger the +30 day extension by committing, when does billing for paid usage start (day 1 of extension or after POC acceptance)?
3) We need the conversion anchor in writing for our CFO — can you provide a simple one-page pricing appendix that states the baseline and the discount tiers?

Procurement/legal are cc'd. They asked whether credits will be invoiced as a one-time line item (zero dollar) or handled as an up-front prepayment/credit note.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call Monday if helpful.

Best,
Sam

Head of ML Platforms, HelioWorks

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional credit schedule & conversion economics — HelioWorks POC

Sam —

Great questions. Short answers up front, then changes to MAP:

- Scope: credits can be shared across project IDs under the same org account; we will tie usage to your org-id but allow multiple API keys for teams.
- Billing start: paid billing begins after the POC is accepted (acceptance = meeting + signoff checklist). The +30 day extension only extends the POC evaluation window; credits apply during the full extended window but paid billing begins after acceptance.
- Pricing appendix: attached as MAP_v2.pdf — includes baseline anchor and explicit discount tiers, plus an early-conversion rebate if you convert within 14 days of acceptance.

Tradeoffs we propose (to make the extension mutually fair):
- If HelioWorks opts for +30 days extension, we require a 12-month minimum committed spend: 6M tokens/month average for the first 3 months, ramping to 20M tokens/month by month 6.
- Discount schedule: 0% below 6M, 8% at 6M-100M, 12% at 100M-500M, 18% at 500M+.
- Early-conversion rebate: 10% credit applied to first invoice if you sign within 14 days of acceptance.

I've also looped Neha (RevOps) to sketch how credits will be recorded on the SOW/invoice.

Attachment: MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 410 KB)

Next steps: if procurement/legal are comfortable, Neha can send a draft SOW with the credit language and provisional pricing appendix for comment. Otherwise we can run a short call to finalize terms.

– Marcus
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: procurement@helioworks.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Draft SOW & billing note — HelioWorks POC (credits handling)

Hi procurement team —

Thanks for reviewing the MAP. Attached is a clean SOW draft that mirrors the MAP_v2 terms and includes a short billing appendix describing how we record pilot credits. Highlights:

- Pilot credits will be issued as a credit note applied to usage; they will not be invoiced as a monetary line item.
- Credits expire at the end of the agreed evaluation window (60 or 90 days depending on extension).
- Any overage during the POC window that exceeds credits is billed as usage at the conversion pricing only after POC acceptance.

Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (Word, 95 KB)

If this aligns with your procurement process, please indicate any redlines and we'll route a version to legal for signature.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Procurement is mostly aligned. Two remaining asks before we put this in our signature queue:

1) A single-line pricing appendix that shows the effective post-conversion price at each discount tier (example: 18% off = $0.000738/token).
2) Confirmation that the early-conversion rebate is applied as account credit on the first invoice and that those credits cannot be used to offset penalties or late fees (procurement policy).

We'd like a 20-min touch base Monday to confirm and then ask legal to prepare our redlines. Can you do 10:30am PT?

Thanks,
Sam

Sam —

Thanks — 10:30am PT Monday works for us. Quick clarifications inline to answer procurement's questions before the call: 

- Effective prices: baseline $0.0009/token. Applying discounts: 8% = $0.000828/token; 12% = $0.000792/token; 18% = $0.000738/token. We'll include these values in a one-page appendix for the SOW.
- Early-conversion rebate: yes, this is applied as an account credit on the first invoice after conversion. Per our billing policy, credits apply only to usage charges and cannot be used to offset contractual penalties, late fees, or third-party charges. We'll add exact wording to the billing appendix.
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 — I've updated the MAP milestones and set a follow-up task for the 10:30am call.

Agenda for Monday (20 mins):
1) Confirm credit expiry and extension trigger language.
2) Agree conversion pricing appendix wording.
3) Confirm SOW routing path for signatures.

If that looks good, we'll send a calendar invite and a redline-ready SOW after the call.

Best,
